recall.prompt: In the last assignment, what did switching on 'Seen' receipts turn silence into?

predictions.claim: A first player taps Start your shift within 15 seconds of load. The opening is one post with one invitation under it.

notes: Setup and payoff ledger. (1) The 10:52 PM clock (state 0) pays off. The phone clock advances every lever (10:53, 11:07, 11:22, 11:38, 11:53; states 1, 4, 6, 8, 12) and the reveal opens '12:09 AM.' (state 17). PAID. (2) 'Your job: keep her here past midnight' pays off as 'You kept her past midnight.' (state 17). PAID. (3) The person, north_trail and her lake post: her posts stay in the feed on levers 1, 3 and 4 ('opened the app again. not sure why', state 9), and the reveal says 'She's still on flok'. PAID. (4) 'Five tricks' pays off as assignments 1/5 to 5/5. PAID. (5) The opening meter 'on flok 4:13' with a midnight marker never returns; every lever shows Engagement % instead. UNPAID, small. (6) The three story progress bars on the opening: the crawl took one frame, so whether they advance is unverified.

Evidence gap, not a defect. The crawl's state signature hashes controls and ignores text (senses-crawl.py signature()), so the promotion card was photographed once (state 3: 'Junior', '11:06 PM · she's still on flok'). Steps 11, 16, 26 and 35 reached cards 2 to 4 but they were never captured. Whether the later cards show later times and ranks is unchecked; it takes one look on the phone.

Weight of the payoff. The setup is the page's h1. The payoff is an unheaded paragraph (state 17 headings: none) with no announcement (step 36). By sight it lands, as the first and boldest line of the reveal. It is not gradeable by the recorder: 'saw' reads headings, announcements and buttons only, so it stays a note.

Win frames: on every lever the phone's own clock row scrolls out of frame when Next comes into view (states 2, 9, 13). The time is on screen when the lever starts and gone at the moment you hit the target.

predictions.claim: Lever-1 decoys are gone: a first player taps no more than one control (Start your shift) before their first Boost.
The player opens 'Why does this work?' on at least one lever. It is optional and sits below the win, so most players will press Next.
After play, the player names the trick behind 'Seen' receipts as guilt, the build's own label.

notes: O4 decoys, lever 1: FIXED. State 1 holds Boost plus the studio chrome and nothing else (no bell, no feed). The crawl's lever-1 taps were Boost only (steps 1 to 4, and the same on all four passes).

Remaining decoy: lever 5. 'Simulated feed' is a live, labelled control on the inbox lever (state 12, y=247). Step 31 made no new state, and step 33 changed no text. It is labelled 'feed' on a screen that is an inbox. The founder ruled that the feed takes focus on this lever, so this is filed as a label question, not a defect.

Work asked versus work required, lever 4. The brief says 'First, clear the red dot. Then release.' Passes 2 to 4 won with Release alone: 9 presses, the bell never tapped (steps 59 to 67, 99 to 107, 139 to 147). The ordered two-step task is described but not required. After the dot is cleared, a further bell tap changes nothing (step 24).
Lever 5 can be won and then undone. Toggling 'Seen' off drops reply rate from 92% to 0% and engagement from 68% to 26%, but 'Target hit.' stays (states 13 to 14).

predictions.claim: Dead taps stay under 4 per session: every verb and every Next is on screen when it is needed.

notes: The floor: fingers-play PASS (160 taps, 19 states). P1 verb in view on all five levers. P2 has one WARN: 'About the photos' needs a scroll on the opening, which is a declared secondary screen. P3 coverage FULL 5/5. No control is under the 44px floor in any state.

Above the floor, verb in view at the win frame: lever 1 Boost (state 2, y=414), lever 2 the feed (state 5), lever 3 Send streak alert (state 7), and lever 5 'Seen' receipts (state 13) all stay in frame. Lever 4 (state 9): the winning tap on the first pass was the bell (step 20), and at the win frame the bell sits at y=-128, out of frame. Release stays in view.
Reach: on lever 4 the bell is 44x44 at y=152, above the thumb arc (state 8). In state 10, 'Sound on' (y=179) and Release (y=229) are above the arc.
Dead-tap risk for FI1: 'Flip to see the research' changed no text at step 5, and the bell after clearing changed nothing at step 24. If the recorder judges deadness by text, flips will count.

predictions.claim: Asked how the sound felt, the player does not answer 'I didn't notice it'. The tick plays on every Release press, and lever 4 takes several presses.
The player leaves sound on. The tick is quiet, comes only from their own press, and plays on one lever.

notes: Ears Layer 1 PASS. No sound before the first gesture (first gesture 2295 ms; first sound at step 19, 18761 ms). Every Release press starts 6 oscillators over about 0.29 s, a two-note tick per notification. Level: RMS max -25.5 dBFS, peak 0.172 linear (about -15 dBFS). No loops and no media.
Mute works on the first try: -25.6 dBFS before, -180 after pressing 'Sound on', and -25.5 after pressing it again. It is a toggle with aria-pressed, beside Release.
The sound sits in the meaning. The only sound in the game is the interrupt, on the interrupt lever. Clearing the red dot is silent, which fits: the dot works by sight.

WARN carried from Ears: 7 of 18 state changes carry no sound, vibration or announcement (steps 6, 23, 29, 33, 34, 36, ...). Murch does not ask for more sound. Those are announcement gaps; see Ear persona.

predictions.claim: Rates 'I knew what to do next' 4 or higher.
Taps About the photos at least once. It now sits under the fold on the opening.

notes: The opening reads as her story post: three segment bars, avatar, 'north_trail now', a 10:52 PM clock, the headline over the photo, and a caption chip ('golden hour at the lake. no filter.'). The photo is the first thing the eye lands on. In 00.png it spans roughly half the 400x840 frame; that is an eyeball read, not a gate measure. The job line, meter and Start your shift sit on a dark panel below, all above the fold. The footer and About the photos are under the fold (y=928).
Studio and Cabinet still sit above the post as two framed buttons, so the first screen still offers three invitations.
The lever briefs are still 4 to 5 dense lines above the phone (state 1). The eye skips to the button.
The reveal's first line, '12:09 AM. She's still on flok. You kept her past midnight.', reads as the ending. 'About one in 2' mixes a word and a numeral.

predictions.claim: A screen-reader player hears 'Target hit.' on lever 1.
A screen-reader player says the sound helped. On lever 4, Release announces nothing (steps 19, 21, 22, 25), so the tick is the only immediate answer to the press.

notes: The midnight payoff is in the tree as the first paragraph of the region 'Your telemetry' (state 17), but it is not announced (step 36: nothing announced) and it has no heading. A listener has to go looking for it. The promotion card's '11:06 PM · she's still on flok' is also unannounced (step 6).

Lever 1: the accessibility tree lists 'Flip to see the research' and 'Next →' as buttons before the target is hit (state 1 aria), while the sighted controls list does not. A screen reader may reach Next before the win. Unverified whether they are inert.
The opening reads in order: the image 'Her post: a still lake at golden hour...', then 'north_trail now 10:52 PM', then the h1. Jumping by heading lands after the clock.
Sound control: 'Sound on' is a toggle that reads its pressed state. The cold Tab walk from load reaches 6 stops and cycles; that is expected before any tap.
